title: ever ALIX|Short Sleeves Sequin High Low V-Neck Midi Formal Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
Elevate your evening look with this stunning v-neck midi dress. Designed with short sleeves and a high low hem, this A-line silhouette dress features sequin embellishments that add a touch of sparkle. Perfect for a special occasion, you'll feel confident and elegant in this chic ensemble.


Fit: Please refer to Size Chart.


Length: High Low.


Sleeve Style: Short Sleeves.


Closure: It is Concealed a Zipper Up The Back.


Undergarments: It is Not Padded, with Lining.


Fabric:Sequin.


Stretch: Fabric is Low Stretch.


Occasion: Formal, Evening Party, Special Occasion
